title: RiffSync catalog bundle
description: Shape of catalog rows in git seed episodes.json (future Dynamo/API may attach additional reconcile-only attributes). Every entry uses the same property set: core fields plus nullable catalog columns.

version.description: Bump when the bundle shape changes incompatibly.

$schema.description: Editor hint pointing at this schema file.

id.description: Stable URL-safe slug; never recycle for another experiment.

title.description: Display title shown in catalog and rooms.

catalog.description: Top-level catalog page assignment. `live` is staff-only (official Live channel sources; omitted from public catalog browse).

labels.description: Short display badges shown on catalog cards.

anyOf.description: YouTube video id when an embed-ready upload exists.

tagline.description: Film tagline from TMDB `movie` detail (typically filled by reconcile).

anyOf.description: Resolved poster CDN URL from TMDB (reconcile).
Resolved backdrop CDN URL from TMDB (reconcile).

tmdbMovieId.description: TMDB movie id after reconcile or manual pin.

tmdbArtworkSyncedAt.description: UTC iso8601 when TMDB-derived fields below were last written (poster, backdrop, tagline, id).

carousel.description: When true, episode is eligible for the home-page hero carousel; `GET /v1/catalog?carousel=true` returns only these rows (sorted by experimentNumber).

spotlight.description: When true, episode is eligible for the home-page spotlight strip; `GET /v1/catalog?spotlight=true` returns only these rows (sorted by experimentNumber).

movieSearchTitle.description: Staff-only TMDB search hint; not exposed on public catalog reads.

embedAllows.description: When false, SPA should not offer in-app YouTube embed; applies to YouTube playback path only. Custom in-app playback is gated by playbackHost and customPlaybackUrl.

playbackHost.description: Staff-selected playback source for this episode. Defaults to youtube when omitted in legacy seed rows (migration/backfill).

anyOf.description: HTTPS movie-page URL when playbackHost is custom. Required non-null when playbackHost is custom.
